# Read of unit U1b, round 2 (goal seat-engines-follow-the-deployed-engine)

Subject: worktree /Users/wido/LocalStorage/GitHub/agentic-tools-ui-seat-engines-follow-the-deployed-engine against base f8cbe53ff91e10d8b1a396f3afcf1109f1415f21.
`git diff --full-index f8cbe53ff` of the worktree is byte-identical to the handed read.diff. The round-1 diff and the round-2 diff (SHA-256 9b2ba472...172ed, checked) differ only by the one hunk in `metasystem/internal/refusal/register.go`.

## Folds checked first

**Correction 1 (revisions/after-1-brief.md): exclude the decision state `deployment-unavailable` from the refusal register. HOLDS.**
- `metasystem/internal/refusal/register.go:474` reads `{Pattern: "deployment-unavailable", Reason: "the engine-follow question's decision state when the deployment cannot be read (internal/steward/engine_follow_ask.go), not a refusal"},`. That is the correction's text word for word, added after the last `Exclusions` entry (`tag-position-proof-unavailable`, :473), as the correction asks.
- The token's only production source is `metasystem/internal/steward/engine_follow_ask.go:16` (`const FollowDeploymentUnavailable = "deployment-unavailable"`). The file the Reason names exists and holds the constant.
- `go test -count=1 ./internal/refusal`: ok. This is the exact command `cmd/devgate/static.go:309` runs as the "refusal register" step that refused round 1.
- Mutation: I removed the line with `go test -overlay`. `TestHCL03EveryCodeRowed` then fails with `collected refusal token "deployment-unavailable" has no row or exclusion` (register_test.go:43). With the line in place, the exclusion is not dead, so register_test.go:48 stays quiet. The test therefore kills the mutation in both directions.
- The pattern is an exact token, not a `*` prefix (`exclusionMatchesCode`, register_test.go:559). It cannot hide any other code.
- `Exclusions` is read only by `internal/refusal/register_test.go`. `internal/ui/uitools/refusal.go` reads `refusal.Rows`. The line therefore changes no runtime behaviour.

**Round-1 findings r1-s3:1 and r1-s3:2.** Both were non-material and needed no change in this unit. `internal/testrun/steward_follow_test.go`, `internal/testrun/steward_follow.go` and `cmd/metasystem/seat_engine_follow.go` are unchanged since round 1, so both notes stand as they were written. They are for the goal's later list and are not re-raised here.

## Findings

None material. AGREE.

## Non-gating observations

- The scope is respected. Correction 1 says "Nothing else" and "Everything else in round 1 stays exactly as it is", and the only change between rounds is that one line.
- Checklist item 2: the frozen proof (`unit-check`, passed in round 2) does not select `./internal/refusal`, as the correction itself says. So the unit's own proof never runs the audit that covers the changed line; only the review's static gate does. I ran that audit and its mutation by hand (above). For the later list, the unit check could select `./internal/refusal` whenever a hyphen-coded literal (`-refused|-unreadable|-malformed|-unavailable`) appears in a directory the register walks, so this class shows up in the build round rather than at the review gate. This is the same class as the known lesson that unit checks never run source-text audits. It is not a defect of this unit.

## Budget

13 of 48 tool calls used. Every checklist item was checked, within this round's scope (the folds, then the changed lines).

VERDICT: land
